description: This file defines shared methods for ResultSet classes related to 'Article' and 'Unit' components in a database schema, including methods to find in-use articles/units and to count related ingredients and items.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::ResultSet::ArticleOrUnit
classes.description: A shared ResultSet class providing common methods for Article and Unit result sets, facilitating queries related to their usage and related counts.

methods.name: in_use
methods.description: Returns a result set of articles or units that are in use, i.e., have any of dish ingredients, recipe ingredients, or purchase list items.

methods.name: with_number_of_ingredients_items
methods.description: Returns a result set with additional virtual columns indicating the count of related dish ingredients, recipe ingredients, and items for each article or unit.
